changelog:
paper-report-ppt 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Generate editable group-meeting PPTX directly from research article PDFs, maintaining the paper’s structure and embedding all figures as-is.
- Fully self-contained: all functions are implemented via built-in Python scripts, requiring only standard pip packages (no external skills).
- Automated, stepwise workflow includes: environment check, PDF parsing (text, figures, formulas), outline generation, slide content structuring, and final PPTX creation.
- Intelligent image filtering, formula rendering, and consistent 17-slide structure based on customizable presentation focus.
- Optional auto-generation of a full speaker draft (DOCX) for oral reports.
- Comprehensive documentation for triggers, inputs, and workflow to facilitate smooth usage by any user.
summary: Turn research PDFs into editable group-meeting PPTX following the paper's structure; embed figures verbatim. Invoke when converting a paper into a group meeting presentation.
